negative_results.claim_under_test: A pre-lock idempotency lookup is sufficient for concurrent duplicate writers.
negative_results.evidence: 80/80 deterministic two-writer same-payload rounds produced one applied write plus one IntegrityError after both writers observed the key absent before serialization.
negative_results.scope: Tested SQLite/Python interleaving only; does not refute single-writer idempotency or all backend strategies.

negative_results.claim_under_test: A UNIQUE idempotency key or INSERT OR IGNORE alone is sufficient to classify semantic replay equivalence.
negative_results.evidence: Different payload under the same key was silently ignored while the original row remained; no explicit payload mismatch/conflict classification was produced.
negative_results.scope: Shows absence of semantic classification in the tested uniqueness-only path; a stronger key construction that binds full semantic operation identity could change the result.
